description: A script that functions as a linter for Zephyr Kconfig files, providing various checks and analysis tools for configuration symbols and references within the Zephyr project.

classes.name: Kconfig
classes.description: Represents the Kconfig configuration tree used for analysis.

classes.name: Symbol
classes.description: Represents a configuration symbol within the Kconfig system.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes the Kconfig environment and runs specified checks.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine which checks to run.

methods.name: check_always_n
methods.description: Checks for symbols that can only be 'n/empty'.

methods.name: check_unused
methods.description: Checks for symbols that appear unused based on heuristics.

methods.name: check_pointless_menuconfigs
methods.description: Finds menuconfig symbols with empty menus.

methods.name: check_defconfig_only_definition
methods.description: Finds symbols only defined in defconfig files.

methods.name: check_missing_config_prefix
methods.description: Detects references to symbols missing the 'CONFIG_' prefix.

methods.name: init_kconfig
methods.description: Initializes the Kconfig environment and loads the configuration tree.
